threshold_entries.rationale: Case Intake must recover the large majority of authored facts before a release candidate can be considered.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: All candidate cases with at least one expected or predicted CaseFact.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Below threshold or N/A blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: The aggregate score must not conceal a poorly extracted fact field.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: Each fact_key having a non-zero expected or predicted denominator.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any applicable field below threshold, or no applicable fields, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: A missing critical field can invalidate downstream gating.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any missed critical fact, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Date normalization feeds deterministic interval decisions and must be exact.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any non-exact date, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Money normalization must not introduce numeric drift.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any non-exact money value, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Nearly all extracted facts must remain traceable to exact user-message spans.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Below threshold or N/A blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: A release candidate must not invent case facts absent from authored labels.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any hallucinated fact, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Macro averaging prevents the two supported IssueCode classes from masking each other.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: All candidate cases across the complete IssueCode taxonomy.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Below threshold or N/A blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Authored critical preliminary issues must never be omitted.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any missed critical issue, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Week-4 refinement is deterministic over a closed typed taxonomy.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: Successful supported-issue cases, macro-averaged over IssueCode and reachable status.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any typed refinement mismatch, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Every expected ACTIVE or POSSIBLE status must match exactly.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any wrong status, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Typed status alone must not conceal an incorrect reason or missing-field trace.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: Every authored refined issue label, including reason and remaining/critical missing fields.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any non-exact refined payload, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Inherited unchanged from the pre-registered deterministic Week-3 gate.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: Successful missing-fact cases in the v1.1 candidate.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any false-positive missing field, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Inherited unchanged from the pre-registered deterministic Week-3 gate.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: Successful missing-fact cases in the v1.1 candidate.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any missed missing field, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Inherited unchanged from the pre-registered deterministic Week-3 gate.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: All emitted clarification questions, including prior-request history.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any duplicate question, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Inherited unchanged; a critical gap must always block substantive readiness.
threshold_entries.applicable_split_cases: All candidate cases labelled with at least one critical missing fact.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any gated case marked substantive-ready, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: The finite CaseGraph route is a deterministic safety contract.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any wrong terminal route, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

threshold_entries.rationale: Every graph terminal must satisfy its typed state invariant.
threshold_entries.failure_semantics: Any invalid terminal state, or an N/A denominator, blocks final PASS.

metric_definitions.overall_fact_f1: Micro F1 over exact per-case (fact_key, fact_type, raw_value) CaseFact signatures.
metric_definitions.fact_field_f1: F1 computed separately for every applicable fact_key; zero denominators are N/A.
metric_definitions.critical_field_recall: Recovered authored critical fact signatures divided by authored critical facts.
metric_definitions.date_exact_match: Exact normalized-value match for authored date_fact_ids.
metric_definitions.money_exact_match: Exact normalized-value match for authored money_fact_ids.
metric_definitions.source_span_accuracy: Expected facts whose predicted exact signature also has an identical typed source span, divided by expected facts.
metric_definitions.hallucinated_fact_rate: Predicted fact signatures absent from the case labels divided by predicted facts.
metric_definitions.candidate_issue_macro_f1: Binary F1 per supported IssueCode, macro-averaged over applicable classes.
metric_definitions.critical_issue_recall: Recovered authored critical IssueCode labels divided by authored critical issues.
metric_definitions.refined_issue_macro_f1: Macro F1 over exact per-case (IssueCode, reachable RefinedIssueStatus) labels.
metric_definitions.refined_issue_status_accuracy: Exact IssueCode/status matches divided by expected refined issues.
metric_definitions.refined_issue_payload_accuracy: Exact IssueCode, status, reason, remaining-field, and critical-field payload matches divided by expected refined issues.
metric_definitions.missing_fact_precision: Exact per-case semantic missing FactKey true positives divided by predicted missing fields.
metric_definitions.missing_fact_recall: Exact per-case semantic missing FactKey true positives divided by expected missing fields.
metric_definitions.duplicate_question_rate: Questions whose FactKey repeats in the round or prior-request history divided by emitted questions.
metric_definitions.critical_fact_leakage: Critical-gap cases marked substantive-ready divided by critical-gap cases.
metric_definitions.graph_route_accuracy: Cases reaching the exact authored CaseAnalysisStatus divided by candidate cases.
metric_definitions.graph_state_contract_accuracy: Cases whose typed graph terminal passes all state invariants divided by candidate cases.

threshold_change_policy: Do not run FINAL/FROZEN evaluation until a human approves this proposal. Never lower the inherited Week-3 gates. Any later change requires a new versioned pre-registration created before seeing final frozen results.
